$comment: v2.3 plan 11 §Fault matrix. Ten stateful packages against ten fault shapes (v2.4 plan 03 added the `aborted` shape and the `hostDeletes` package, decision E8), one row per cell, each either citing the test that demonstrates it or saying what is not yet demonstrated. Generated set, hand-classified status. The guard in src/runtime/faultMatrix.guard.test.ts fails when this file and the code disagree: a missing pair, a row for a pair the matrix does not have, a citation whose test is not in the file it names, or an unproven cell that still cites something. Statuses: covered (a test asserts the designed behaviour for this package under this fault) | partial (a test covers part of it, and the note says which part) | todo (nothing covers it) | na (the shape cannot apply, and the note says why).

extraction|delayedSuccess.note: A gated model answer released after the awaits still lands in its own chat.

extraction|delayedError.note: A job's failure is not allowed to surface at the boundary however late it arrives; the scheduler owns the error.

extraction|malformedResponse.note: Junk deltas are rejected line by line and nothing is accepted from them.

extraction|duplicateCompletion.note: Queued duplicate scene passes coalesce under pressure; no test delivers one completion twice.

extraction|backendUnavailable.evidence: src/extraction/scheduler.breaker.test.ts#a dead profile never writes extraction.enabled and resumes on probe success
alsoEvidence: src/runtime/repair.test.ts#names the enabled-but-unprofiled case differently from the switched-off one
src/extraction/scheduler.breaker.test.ts#a deleted profile is config, named as missing, and a created one re-evaluates it away
extraction|backendUnavailable.note: v2.4 plan 03 D3: a dead backend opens an in-memory breaker keyed by profile (never persisted): reads are held, extraction.enabled is never written, and a probe (5 s/15 s/60 s/300 s, online-status, profile update, Try again) resumes the held queue. A missing or deleted profile is config (not-configured + Repair), not transport. Previously partial: The surface names an enabled-but-unprofiled extraction; no test drives the scheduler itself with no reachable profile.

extraction|beforeHostWrite.note: Extraction writes the memory tiers and its audit ring (runtime state). It performs no host write of its own, so there is nothing to fail before.

extraction|afterHostWrite.note: Same: the one host-visible effect of a scene break (the reply) is fired by the effects applier, not here.

extraction|persistFailure.note: The coordinator performs no persist of its own: it writes its extras slice and asks the manager to save (the architecture guard enforces this). A failing save is the persistence package, whose row covers it, and a save that never happened only costs a repeated read.

extraction|worldSwitched.evidence: src/runtime/coordinators/extractionOwnership.review.test.ts#an audit whose chat changed during verification writes nothing
extraction|worldSwitched.note: An audit whose world moves during the verify await deposits nothing.

extraction|aborted.evidence: src/extraction/scheduler.test.ts#an aborted read is not retried and records no error
alsoEvidence: src/runtime/runOwner.abort.test.ts#rollback aborts the read in its window
src/extraction/schedulerReread.review.test.ts#a read cancelled by an in-window edit with nothing to roll back is re-read
src/extraction/schedulerReread.review.test.ts#control: a chat switch lapse is not re-read
src/extraction/schedulerReread.review.test.ts#control: an overlapping rollback re-read is not duplicated
extraction|aborted.note: v2.4 plan 03: a rollback inside the read's window, a chat switch or Stop aborts the host request (RunOwner live registry); the scheduler treats the lapse as discarded work: no retry, no lastError, no breaker count, a journal line. The backlog's Stop exits cleanly with running:false. Live-found fix (2026-09-24): a read that lapsed on a mutation inside its window (reason window, same epoch) is re-queued as a P0 reread:lapsed over its window re-clamped to the chat, once the rollback that mutation started has settled; it merges into an overlapping queued rollback re-read, and a chat/story switch lapse is never re-read.

persistence|malformedResponse.note: v2.4 plan 02 T11. An unrecognized stored blob (v5+, a non-numeric or missing version, broken stories) is read detached and never written: every automatic write refuses it (the it.each byte-identical rows in the same file), an explicit selection is refused, and only a confirmed Restart replaces it. Before T11 the old evidence (persistenceMigration 'ignores anything that is not a v2 blob') was true of the migration only: getMetadataBlob then wrote createBlob() over the blob, so 'ignored' meant destroyed on the next save.

effects|persistFailure.evidence: src/runtime/effectsApplier.test.ts#refuses it, and says why, when the pending row is still unsaved
effects|persistFailure.note: FOUND BY THIS CENSUS and FIXED: the applier persisted the write-ahead pending row and then ran the host write regardless, and persist() cannot say whether the row reached disk (saveMetadata swallows its own errors). It now reads the save-evidence seam (`unsaved`, i.e. hasUnsavedChanges) after the write-ahead persist and REFUSES the effect, marking the row failed with PENDING_NOT_SAVED — no effect without a durable record. The sibling case (the row is saved, the effect runs) is the same describe block.
